title: Industry Norms and Worker Perspectives
goal: Describe unnamed employer practices with third-person plural impersonals and general worker experience with indefinite uno/una.
grammar: third-person plural impersonals and indefinite uno/una

items: I can describe unnamed employer or sector practices with a subjectless third-person plural verb.
I can generalise a worker's experience with *uno / una* and consistent third-person singular agreement.
I can use terms for self-employment, payroll, benefits, outsourcing, seniority and dismissal.
